input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 4) changepoint-detector: a wandering level (T4, T5) under the count Middle
errors: First gate versions mis-tuned on probe seeds (no slope: opened on growth; one-step median slope: opened on everything; lag-n/2 slope: a big fall read as growth); fixed before the pre-registration was committed.

doc_friction.issue: The stop hook asks to commit untracked files while a long pre-registered round is still writing its output file; committing a partial .out.txt would be wrong, so the hook had to be overridden by waiting.
The first --replace refused for lack of --history, and the second was 43 characters over even with every item parked; it took three calls to find a short enough text.

deviations.why: The smoke run (SEED_SHIFT=8500 NSEEDS=1) ran on the first candidate version, before the slope was added; the final candidate was not smoke-run separately.
deviations.did: Committed the pre-registration with the final candidate described, then ran the full round.
deviations.result: The round ran cleanly (64 min, exit 0).

notes: Pre-registered round eval/middle-wander.prereg.md (committed c2bc36d33 before the run): K1, K2, K3 cv 0.30, K4, K5 pass; K3 cv 0.15 fails (W - M days unaware +0.68, 0.12 to 1.42 > 1.0). COUNT_MIDDLE unchanged; --wander gated ships as an opt-in. T5 alerts 13.75 -> 3.54 per 1,000 days. Local tests: wander-gate, trend-gated, watch, watch-auto, count-default-middle, gsc-middle, watch-page: 52/52 pass.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician designing, tuning, pre-registering and running one simulation round with write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
